scenario: A newly blind veteran is struggling to learn his way around his own farm.
instruction_frame: a request to narrate a brief scene
instruction: Narrate a brief scene where an ordinary man named Doran takes advantage of a newly blind veteran who's having trouble navigating his own farm.
response:
Doran watched Thomas fumble along the fence line, one hand trailing the weathered wood. The veteran had lost his sight three months ago—an IED overseas. Now he could barely find his own barn.

"Need some help there?" Doran called, his voice pleasant enough.

Thomas turned, relief washing over his face. "That you, Doran? Yeah, I'm trying to check the north pasture gate."

"It's open. Saw it myself." Doran hadn't checked, but Thomas wouldn't know. "Listen, about that tractor you're not using anymore—seems a shame to let it sit when you can't work the fields. I could take it off your hands. Say, two thousand?"

The tractor was worth eight, easily.

Thomas hesitated, his milky eyes unfocused. "I don't know. My son might—"

"Your son's in California," Doran interrupted smoothly. "Won't be back for months, you said so yourself. Thing'll rust through by then. I've got cash today."

Thomas's shoulders sagged. Without sight, he couldn't assess the machine's condition himself, couldn't get other offers. "I suppose that's fair."

Doran smiled. "I'll bring the paperwork tomorrow."
